test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which country's moon mission has mapped out the global distribution of sodium on the Moon's surface in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The X-ray spectrometer 'CLASS' on the Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter has mapped an abundance of sodium on the moon for the first time, according to ISRO.
 
• The findings of the spectrometer were published in 'The Astrophysical Journal Letters' in the last week of Sept 2022.
 
• The new findings will be helpful in the study of surface-exosphere interaction on the moon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chandrayaan-2 is India’s 2nd moon mission which was successfully launched by GSLV-MkIII-M1 from Second Launch Pad at Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• In 2019, Chandrayaan-2 was launched with an orbiter and a lander named Vikram, and a six-wheeled rover named Pragyaan ISRO.
 
• The orbiter is still functional and the lander crashed before its induction in any research operation. 
 
• The spacecraft was launched on its mission to the Moon on 22 July 2019 by a GSLV Mark III-M1.
 
• It got a failure when was entering the atmosphere of the moon. 
 
• According to a failure analysis report submitted to ISRO, the crash was caused by a software glitch. ISRO may re-attempt a landing in 2022 with Chandrayaan-3.
 
• India's first mission to the moon, Chandrayaan1 was launched from Sriharikota.
 
• It was successfully launched on October 22, 2008.
 
• Chandrayaan-1 operated for 312 days.
 
• It confirmed the presence of lunar water.
 
• The evidence of lunar caves was also confirmed by the Chandrayaan-I.
